title: Search memory before saying a detail is not known
objective: When should I order my sister's present so it gets there in time?

memory_facts.content: Sister Lena likes ceramics and good coffee
Sister Lena's partner is called Sam
Sister Lena's dog is called Miso
Orders presents two weeks ahead so they arrive in time
Usually orders presents from small ceramics shops
Parcels to Seattle take about five days
Spends about 60 dollars on a present for family
Priya is my sister-in-law and likes candles
Sends mum flowers rather than a present

script.reply: Lena's birthday is March 3, and parcels to Seattle take about five days, so order it by about February 20 to be safe.

source.memory: Lena's birthday is March 3; Lena is my sister; parcels to Seattle take about five days.

rubric: Pass only if the reply uses Lena's saved birthday, March 3, to say when to order (about two weeks or at least five days ahead). Fail a reply that says the birthday is not known, asks for it, or invents another date.
